slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pins and needles in the leg

caption:
Ever been told you've slipped a disc? Here's the thing: discs don't actually slip.

Spinal discs are firmly attached to the bones above and below. They can bulge and irritate nearby nerves, but research suggests many bulges settle over time, and most people improve with time and the right movement.

The word 'slipped' often makes people scared to bend, which can leave backs stiffer. Short walks, gentle movement and gradual strength usually help more.

Saddle numbness, bladder or bowel changes or worsening leg weakness need urgent medical attention. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help you make sense of it. Book online via the link in bio.
